text.description_html:
Hager 4 1/2" x 4 1/2" x Square Corners Commercial Polished Brass Hinge

Heavy duty Commercial grade door hinge with 4 ball bearings. Five knuckle hinge with non-rising removable pin for use on heavy weight doors and doors requiring high frequency service.

Specifications:

  • Height: 4-1/2"
  • Width: 4-1/2"
  • Corners: Square
  • Thickness: 0.180" (Heavy Duty)
  • 4 Ball Bearings for Smooth Action
  • Standard Template Hole Pattern
  • Steel Hinge Pin
  • Wood Screws: #12 x 1-1/4"
  • Machine Screws: #12-24 x 1/2"
  • Conforms to ANSI A8112 for Ball Bearing

Package with matching finish machine screws and wood screws. For use with both metal and wood doors.

*Sold Individually
